flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open Hati with no saved data (if any bills or people exist @v16:"clear this site's browser storage and reload").
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy.
Add a bill named Rent with amount 900.00, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy.
Confirm the Rent bill is listed.

Reload the page and look at the bill list.
Assert The Rent bill is still listed after the reload.
Assert The Rent bill still shows 900.00.
Store The amount shown for the Rent bill after the reload as 'bill_after_reload'.
